_comment: Checked-in canned-detect fixture (Alt C) that drives the derive of api/examples/best-goal_cache.json. Same posture as fake_detect_4625.json: a configurable FakeAzureVision(objects=...) returns THESE objects at every sampled frame, so the cache is reproduced deterministically with NO creds and NO .mov. Contains 5 persons (so the count query grounds to 5) + 1 ball (verifies class filtering: detect_classes is [person], so the ball is dropped). The highest-confidence person (conf 0.81, box x:0.12) is positioned to be the nearest match for the manifest pin's nearest_box {x:0.12,y:0.2,w:0.18,h:0.6} -> renamed to p_seven, read_text '7'. Boxes are well-separated so nearest-box pin matching is unambiguous. Consumed by test_catalog_multiclip.py (derive + replay) — these timestamps-agnostic objects are emitted at each of the 41 frames sampled over 8000-13000ms @8fps.
